people-w1-apply.ref: statenour/people-w1-apply (job 2026-10-30-people-tracker, W1 apply; manager ruling C). The plan is a LOCAL file the runner names (--plan --out <file>, ids, kind and times only) and its token is a short sha256 of that file; --execute --plan-file <file> --token <t> re-hashes and refuses on any mismatch before the backup, then copies relationship_ledger to _bak_relationship_ledger_people_w1_20261030 (CREATE TABLE, so a second run cannot overwrite it), compares counts, and writes exactly the file's rows through insertWithinWindow: a row is written only when no CONTACT row sits inside its [start, end] window (the planner's bounded rule, not recordInteractionOnce's one-sided one, Codex P1 on 3419), via recordInteraction with a generic note, creditXp false, metadata.via backfill:conversation_digest. A failing row is counted and the run exits 1. Red first: fileToken and insertWithinWindow missing, the start field, the row-failure case; 34 tests (apply, planner, ledger-reader guard) under TZ=UTC and America/New_York. Script typecheck (scoped tsconfig) exit 0. Refusals proven on the real script with no database: no --plan-file, no --token, no --out, the retired --apply all exit 2 before Prisma loads; a real file with a wrong token returns token_mismatch, exit 1. Nothing was run against production in this change; the manager runs --plan and --execute.
